A RESOLUTION TO APPOINT ABSENTEE BALLOT STAFF FOR THE ABSENTEE AND ADVANCE VOTING PERIOD DATING FROM OCTOBER 17, 2011 THROUGH NOVEMBER 4, 2011, FOR THE NOVEMBER 8, 2011 GENERAL ELECTION

WHEREAS, _ the General Election for the Town of Clermont will be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2011 for three Council seats upon the Town Council of the Town of Clermont; and

WHEREAS, _ the Town of Clermont (City Hall) located at 122 Dean Street, Clermont, Georgia 30527 will serve as the Absentee Precinct for the Absentee and Advance Voting period dating from October 17, 2011 through November 4, 2011 for the November 8, 2011 General Election; and

WHEREAS, 0.C.G.A. 21-2-90 requires the municipal governing authority to appoint at least three (3) poll officers consisting of a chief manager and two assistant managers; and

WHEREAS, 0.C.G.A. 21-2-380.1 requires the municipal governing authority to appoint an absentee ballot clerk; and

WHEREAS, the three (3) poll officers and the absentee ballot clerk will serve during the absentee/advance voting period dating from October 17, 2011 through November 4, 2011.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia as Follows:
